cases.case_label: SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP): somatic (CCCTCT)n instability in brain
cases.mechanism_detail: Study of the (CCCTCT)n repeat within the 2.6-kb XDP SVA in postmortem tissues of 2 patients; basal ganglia and cerebellum showed larger and more unstable repeats than blood, suggesting somatic instability may modify disease. Mechanism of the SVA's effect on TAF1 not investigated.
cases.quote: Somatic repeat instability may predominate in brain regions selectively affected in XDP, thereby hinting at its potential role in disease manifestation and modification.
